title: Z Fellows
description: A one-week program that brings together ten technical builders with founders of billion-dollar companies, with support for the life of your company. Fellows can take a $10,000 investment at a $1B valuation cap, or join without money. Mostly virtual, with the last day in person in San Francisco or New York. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
reward: A $10,000 investment at a $1B valuation cap if you want it (you can also join without money), converting to stock at your next priced round
each_time: personal answers about you, your work and your drive
rules: Rolling: there is no deadline. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, Z Fellows runs multiple cohorts each year, and rejected applicants can reapply.
One week with ten builders per cohort. Mostly virtual; the last day is in person in San Francisco or New York, and most fellows spend the whole week in one of those cities.
Taking money is up to you: join without it, or take $10,000 at a $1B valuation cap that converts to stock at your next priced round.
For technical builders anywhere in the world, of any age, working on side projects or startups. No company, team, dropping out or quitting your job needed.
Apply solo or with co-founders; one application per team.
